description: This file defines a template class 'BinaryInterface' within the WebSockets namespace, which provides an interface for binary WebSocket communication. It includes methods for sending messages and setting a message handler, relying on derived classes for actual message sending implementation.

classes.name: BinaryInterface
classes.description: A template interface class providing methods to send binary messages and set message handlers for WebSocket communication, intended to be inherited by concrete WebSocket implementations.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message by invoking the derived class's send method.

methods.name: setOnMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback function to handle incoming messages.
